name: Kashmir
description: Nestled in the northernmost realm of India, Kashmir is famed for its snow-capped peaks, pristine Dal Lake shikara rides, serene valleys of Gulmarg and Pahalgam, and rich saffron heritage. A dream destination for luxury, honeymoon, and nature lovers.
highlights: Shikara Ride & Houseboat Stay on Dal Lake
Gondola Cable Car Ride in Gulmarg
Betaab Valley & Aru Valley Exploration
Saffron Fields & Apple Orchards of Pampore
bestTimeToVisit: March to August (Spring/Summer) or Dec to Feb (Snowfall)

name: Kerala
description: From mist-clad tea plantations in Munnar to serene backwater cruises in Alleppey and wildlife sanctuaries in Thekkady, Kerala offers an enchanting blend of tranquility, luxury ayurvedic wellness, and cultural riches.
highlights: Private Luxury Houseboat Cruise in Alleppey
Munnar Tea Estate Walk & Tasting
Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary Safari in Thekkady
Authentic Ayurvedic Spa & Wellness Retreats

name: Bali, Indonesia
description: Bali is a tropical sanctuary famous for lush volcanic peaks, sacred water temples, iconic rice terraces in Ubud, turquoise cliffside beaches in Uluwatu, and world-class luxury villas with private infinity pools.
highlights: Tegallalang Rice Terraces & Jungle Swing
Private Pool Villa Experience in Seminyak
Sunset Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Temple
Speedboat Day Trip to Nusa Penida & Kelingking Beach

name: Dubai, UAE
description: Experience ultra-modern architecture, desert luxury, Michelin-star dining, futuristic attractions, world-class shopping, and dune bash safaris in the dazzling metropolis of Dubai.
highlights: Burj Khalifa 124th & 125th Floor Observation Deck
Luxury Red Dune Desert Safari & BBQ Dinner
Museum of the Future & Dubai Frame Visit
Private Yacht Marina Cruise

name: Himachal & Manali
description: Immerse yourself in mountain breeze, pine forests, Solang Valley adventure sports, Atal Tunnel, and serene Himalayan hamlets like Kasol, Old Manali, and Sethan.
highlights: Atal Tunnel & Sissu Waterfall Day Excursion
Paragliding & Snow Activities at Solang Valley
Old Manali Cafe Culture & Hadimba Temple
Trek to Jogini Waterfalls

name: Thailand
description: Golden temples in Bangkok, vibrant nightlife in Phuket, island hopping around Phi Phi Islands, and crystal-clear waters of Krabi make Thailand an irresistible getaway.
highlights: Phi Phi Island Speedboat Tour & Maya Bay
Coral Island Watersports in Pattaya
Bangkok Grand Palace & Floating Market
Luxury Sunset Catamaran Cruise in Phuket
